title: Ooze bomb

infobox.Crafting Materials: Leather scraps x5, Ooze x5, Resin x3

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Ooze bomb is a thrown weapon that creates a Poison 4-meter radius AoE cloud, which stays for 10 seconds. Anyone in the cloud (excluding the thrower) takes 40 poison damage over 7 seconds. If an enemy stays in the cloud, the damage is refreshed, so the maximum damage is 40*(10+7)/7 = 97.
Damage value does not depend on any player skill, but may be altered by enemy resistance.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
• Crafted with the Workbench, stacks up to 50
• Ooze can be found in the Swamp biome by killing Blobs and Oozers
• Leather scraps are found in Chests in the Meadows biome, dropped from Boars or Bats or mined from Muddy scrap piles.
• Resin is dropped by Greydwarf, Greydwarf shaman and Greydwarf brute. It has a chance of dropping from chopped Birch and Pine trees, and Smaller Beech Trees.
